title: Floors and wall base finish materials.
officialText:
Toilet, bathing, and shower room floor finish materials shall have a smooth, hard,
nonabsorbent surface. The intersections of such floors with walls shall have a smooth, hard, nonabsorbent vertical base that
extends upward onto the walls at least 4 inches (101.6 mm).
Exception: Occupancy Classes I-1, R-1 and R-2 shall have a vertical base that extends upward onto walls at least 6 inches (152
mm).
